note: How Direct Saver works: easy access, interest added yearly, variable rate can change
How Income Bonds work: easy access, monthly interest, variable
How the Direct ISA works: tax-free, not a flexible ISA, age 18 or over
How the Junior ISA works: locked until 18, who manages it, becomes an adult cash ISA
Guaranteed Growth Bonds (British Savings Bonds): fixed terms, no access, tax in the maturity year
Guaranteed Income Bonds (British Savings Bonds): fixed terms, monthly income
Green Savings Bonds: fixed term, online only, green projects
